tools.name: list_calendars
tools.description: Shipped calendars: id, name, source URL, Saturday and Sunday rules, coverage, last verified, and changelog. us-federal-opm is the default. us-nyse covers 2026-01-01 through 2028-12-31. us-sifma covers 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31. us-ca covers 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. us-ny covers 2026-01-01

tools.name: list_holidays
tools.description: Holiday rows for one year. us-federal-opm and us-fed-banking return the eleven nationwide legal public holidays. On us-fed-banking, observed is null when the legal date is a Saturday, because Friday stays open. us-nyse returns the NYSE full-day table and accepts only 2026 through 2028. us-sifma retu

tools.name: is_business_day
tools.description: Whether a civil date is a business day, and why. Omit calendar for us-federal-opm (US federal offices). us-fed-banking is the Federal Reserve Banks schedule: a Saturday holiday does not close the preceding Friday. us-nyse is NYSE full-day holidays for 2026 through 2028. us-sifma is SIFMA recommended

tools.name: add_business_days
tools.description: The date that is days business days after start. The start date is day 0, matching Excel WORKDAY, so days=1 always leaves the start date. days is an integer from -3660 to 3660. Omit calendar for us-federal-opm. us-fed-banking keeps Reserve Banks open on the Friday before a Saturday holiday.

tools.name: count_business_days
tools.description: How many business days are in the inclusive span from start through end, matching Excel NETWORKDAYS. Negative when end is earlier. The span must be 3660 days or less. Omit calendar for us-federal-opm.

tools.name: roll_date
tools.description: Stay on date when it is already a business day. Otherwise move to the nearest business day in direction next or previous. This is not Excel WORKDAY, and it does not decide whether a filing is timely. Omit calendar for us-federal-opm.

tools.name: frcp_6a_deadline
tools.description: Count a period stated in days under Fed. R. Civ. P. 6(a)(1). Exclude the trigger day. Count every calendar day, including intermediate Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays. Roll only the last day. direction is after or before. days is an integer from 1 to 3660. There is no calendar argument. Legal

tools.name: report_discrepancy
tools.description: Store a suspected wrong closing for later review. Requires calendar, date, claim, and source_url. The report is not applied to either calendar. The result is accepted true and applied false. claim is one line of at most 500 characters. source_url is an http or https URL with no username or password.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_discrepancy" references sensitive artifacts (password). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_calendars · Private data: report_discrepancy · Public sink: report_discrepancy.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_calendars · Private data: report_discrepancy · Public sink: report_discrepancy

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
